name: pstack
description: Community port of Lauren Tan's pstack for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Community port of pstack for Codex
interface.longDescription: The adapter translates pstack's Cursor instructions for Codex. It maps file reads and searches to Codex shell commands, checklists to update_plan or chat, and subagent and model settings to their Codex equivalents. It also tells Codex where to find the bundled skills and references.
